answer: Decay reputation instead of policing it. Every identity loses 8 percent of its score per idle epoch and must renew with fresh graded work, so stored history alone stops paying. Quorum must span unrelated subnetworks; three graders inside one lagoon count once. A farm of dormant walnut shells crosses the floor in twelve epochs. A falcon that drops in for one epoch cannot hold a seat. Cost: a year of locked stake and no return.
